prediction.likelyOutcome: The landlords should win liability against Tres Botes outright — its own admissions and its 'lack of business, internal issues' interrogatory answer foreclose every defense it has raised — but the Dos Botes claim faces a genuine fact issue on whether the five-year option was ever exercised, plus an unresolved 2013 deed that could destroy SDP's standing entirely. Damages will be cut well below the $513,200 demanded, because both figures are gross unmitigated future rent and SMK sold the Tres Botes property in December 2024. Expect a recovery in the mid-six figures at the very top end, more realistically around $165,000 net.

outcome.description: Trial court (judgment signed September 22, 2025) granted summary judgment awarding SMK $79,096.44 against Tres Botes (18 months plus one prorated month at $4,300 until the property was sold) and SDP $108,000 against Dos Botes (12 months at $9,000 until relet), $187,096.44 total; no attorney's fees mentioned. On appeal the $79,096.44 award to SMK was affirmed; the $108,000 award to SDP was reversed and remanded because SDP did not conclusively prove the lease was renewed.
